name: Nose and Cavum Anomaly

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Nose and Cavum Anomaly Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of congenital structural malformation of the external nose
Anomalous development or absence of the nasopharyngeal cavum confirmed by imaging
Clinical evidence of nasal airway obstruction or impaired nasal breathing
Presence of associated facial dysmorphic features such as midface hypoplasia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both major criteria (nasal structural malformation and nasopharyngeal cavum abnormality) with or without minor supportive features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging studies such as MRI or CT of the nasal and nasopharyngeal region.

searchTerms: absent or small upper throat cavity
nasopharyngeal opening is absent or small

common.symptomName: Recurrent otitis media due to Eustachian tube dysfunction
searchTerms: repeated ear infections from Eustachian tube problems
chronic ear infections due to tube dysfunction
snoring and breathing problems during sleep

rare.symptomName: Cranial nerve palsies affecting facial muscles
searchTerms: weakness of facial muscles from nerve damage
facial nerve palsy causing muscle problems

rare.symptomName: Developmental delay related to chronic hypoxia
searchTerms: slow development related to chronic hypoxia
learning or growth delays due to low oxygen

imaging: MRI or CT showing absence or hypoplasia of the nasopharyngeal cavum
Imaging evidence of nasal bone and cartilage malformations
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; possible sporadic or syndromic association
other: Clinical examination revealing nasal deformity and airway obstruction

distinguishingFeatures: Complete or partial bony or membranous obstruction of the posterior nasal airway
Usually unilateral or bilateral choanal blockage without external nasal deformity
Multiple craniofacial bone abnormalities including midface hypoplasia
Associated with syndromic features such as limb anomalies

redFlags: Failure to thrive due to feeding difficulties
Recurrent severe otitis media with hearing impairment
